description: This file implements the SqlPostPriorityStore class with methods for managing post priority data in a database, including retrieval, saving, and deletion of post priority records, handling persistent notifications, acknowledgements, and updating post timestamps.

classes.name: SqlPostPriorityStore
classes.description: A class that manages post priority data in the database, providing methods to get, save, and delete post priorities.

methods.name: newSqlPostPriorityStore
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new SqlPostPriorityStore instance.

methods.name: GetForPost
methods.description: Retrieves the post priority for a specific post ID.

methods.name: GetForPostWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves the post priority for a specific post ID within a given request context.

methods.name: GetForPosts
methods.description: Retrieves post priorities for multiple post IDs, batching requests in groups of 200.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a post priority record, handling updates to persistent notifications, acknowledgements, and post timestamp.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a post priority and related data for a specific post ID.
